plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Eliminate spurious WARNING log entries on piCorePlayer and standalone yt-dlp installs. Once persistent YDL is detected as unavailable, subsequent attempts are skipped silently and logged at INFO level instead of WARNING. Playback via subprocess fallback is unaffected.
plugin.creator: schmij97
